title: Deploy precision agriculture sensing
description: Use field sensing and decision support to target water, fertilizer, and crop interventions.
assumptions: Assumes farmers have connectivity, training, and maintenance support.

title: Expand cold-chain monitoring
description: Instrument storage and transport to reduce food loss and improve reliable access to nutritious food.
source_hint: SOFI food access and agrifood-system evidence
assumptions: Assumes dependable power, logistics partners, and operating funding.

title: Implement supply-chain traceability
description: Track critical inputs and food flows to surface bottlenecks, provenance, and disruption exposure.
source_hint: SEC supply-chain risks and SOFI food-access evidence
assumptions: Assumes suppliers will provide consistent and interoperable data.

title: Harden climate-resilient digital infrastructure
description: Improve resilient connectivity for food-system monitoring and service continuity during climate shocks.
assumptions: Assumes local power resilience and lifecycle support are included.

title: Prioritize energy-efficient infrastructure refresh
description: Replace inefficient infrastructure where lifecycle savings and service resilience justify investment.
assumptions: Assumes measured baseline energy use and responsible equipment disposal.

title: Expand malnutrition screening access
description: Improve access to screening and referral workflows for populations exposed to malnutrition.
assumptions: Assumes clinical governance, trained staff, referral capacity, and validated instruments.

title: Diversify critical suppliers
description: Qualify alternate suppliers for critical components and services to reduce concentration risk.
assumptions: Assumes alternatives pass quality, security, and compliance due diligence.

title: Establish disruption scenario planning
description: Model climate, conflict, price, and supplier disruptions with predefined response thresholds.
source_hint: SOFI drivers and SEC risk-factor evidence
assumptions: Assumes accountable owners review indicators and exercise response plans.

title: Target affordability support using local data
description: Use price and access indicators to target assistance where healthy diets are least affordable.
assumptions: Assumes privacy-preserving data and validated eligibility rules.

title: Build food-security early-warning dashboards
description: Combine climate, market, logistics, and nutrition indicators for earlier intervention decisions.
source_hint: SOFI food-security drivers and monitoring evidence
assumptions: Assumes timely data feeds and agreed escalation thresholds.

title: Standardize partner due diligence
description: Assess financial, regulatory, operational, and sustainability exposure before critical partnerships.
source_hint: SEC regulatory and operational risk evidence
assumptions: Assumes risk owners maintain evidence and reassess material changes.

title: Pilot resilient local procurement
description: Diversify procurement toward qualified local sources where this improves continuity and access.
source_hint: SOFI rural-urban continuum and market-access evidence
assumptions: Assumes local suppliers meet quality, capacity, and compliance requirements.
